title: Concept: Multi-document YAML load via yaml.load_all (python) — review required
description: In python, yaml.load_all parses each document of a YAML stream with the default loader. YAML tags can name Python constructors, so a crafted multi-document file can build dangerous objects before any application validation. Use the safe loader for every document (yaml.safe_load_all).
applicability: python configuration and import paths that accept multi-document YAML; lexical scope.
risk: Code execution from a crafted document set; HIGH severity.
